notes.title: Improvements (Ver 1.0.4)
notes.content:
- Added recovery process when stuck.

- The text of some buttons has been made easier to understand.


# Please note that we will not be able to match players with different versions of the game.

notes.title: Improved playability (Ver. 1.0.3)
notes.content:
- Overall operability has been improved.

- Flag placement status is now saved in saved data.

- Added a setting to enable/disable other players' light.


# Please note that we will not be able to match players with different versions of the game.

tags.feature: - Added a setting to enable/disable other players' light.

notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.0.2)
notes.content:
- Fixed a problem that sometimes caused stuttering.

- Fixed a problem in Stage 3 where the user could climb places that should not be climbable.

notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.0.1)
notes.content:
- Fixed a problem that could cause a rare stuck on the ground when "Return to flag" is selected.

- Fixed a memory leak problem.
